accessible_pending_status_note: Pending-state labels, follow-up instructions, and later status/help transitions remain available in accessible text and are reviewable with common assistive technology and mobile constraints.
authoritative_status_path_note: When later status checking matters, the route identifies one authoritative page, phone path, or office-help lane for interpreting unresolved requests.
checkback_or_followup_note: The route states whether the voter should check status on a specific official path, wait for a follow-up notice, or contact the office after a visible threshold.
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that accept a request but do not resolve immediately keep unresolved post-submit state, check-back posture, reference-number reuse, and escalation-after-silence clear enough that the voter does not have to guess what happens next.
ordinary_processing_window_note: The route gives an ordinary check-back window or follow-up expectation when immediate resolution is not promised.
pending_review_surface_label: Example State official voter-information post-submit pending-status fail-open policy
pending_state_vocabulary_note: The route explains the ordinary unresolved post-submit states a voter may encounter, such as received, under review, more information needed, completed, closed, or status unavailable.
reference_number_reuse_note: The route makes clear whether any reference or case number is only a receipt or can also be used later on an official status or help path.
silence_escalation_note: The route tells the voter when lack of update stops being ordinary and should trigger a status lookup, contact with the office, or another help lane.
waiting_on_office_vs_voter_note: The route distinguishes office-side review from voter-action-needed, follow-up delivery problems, and true status unavailability.
